page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-48-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs and 372 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.75 GB per core, positioning it within the memory-optimized category for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity per compute unit.

The server includes 3221 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 8 local SSDs. This integrated storage configuration provides high-capacity local block storage directly attached to the instance. The server does not include any GPU hardware, meaning all processing tasks rely solely on the 48 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-highmem-48-lssd offers high resource density by combining a large memory footprint with substantial local NVMe SSD capacity on a single node. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and transactional databases that require low-latency local storage access without the need for GPU acceleration.
